files.description: Authoritative threat model for the Blast Chambers sandbox. Defines the refusal contract and the Activation rule listing every criterion that must hold before the subsystem may report available.
The activation manifest. Each key is one acceptance criterion gating the sandbox. Compare it against the Activation rule in the threat model.

States the two standards this repository reviews against: preserve the distinction between facts known before import and failures discovered after an import attempt, and ship a negative test with every security fix.
Supported versions and the disclosure process.
